identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized,Double-blind,Placebo,Positive-controlled Phase III Trial of VDJ001 In Patients With Moderate-to-severe Active Rheumatoid Arthritis

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, and active drug-controlled Phase III pivotal clinical trial of recombinant humanized anti-interleukin-6 receptor monoclonal antibody injection (VDJ001) for the treatment of moderate-to-severe active rheumatoid arthritis with poor response to methotrexate
